evidence_limits: Development checks only; no release or physical hardware qualification.
Physical samples poll one PAL frame at a time; sub-frame differences are not meaningful.
Move client and combined scene endpoints exclude pointer, menu/title and dynamic status pixels.
Move application repaint counts are sampled after settlement; a separate final-app timestamp was not recorded.
Passive C text entry counts include caret and native content; the focus fixture separately counts Shell restoration cells/copies.
Trace records count copy calls, not transferred byte totals or all individual fallback reasons.
